name: Maddrey
description: Predicts prognosis and guides steroid therapy in alcoholic hepatitis

Maddrey's Discriminant Function (mDF)

Predicts prognosis and guides steroid therapy in alcoholic hepatitis

Normal: 11-13.5 seconds
Usually 12-14 seconds (lab dependent)
Formula: mDF = 4.6 × (PT - Control PT) + Bilirubin (mg/dL)
Interpretation:
• mDF <32: Mild disease, supportive care
• mDF ≥32: Severe alcoholic hepatitis, consider corticosteroids
Reference: Maddrey WC et al. Gastroenterology 1978
